trap.label: inversão condicional
trap.wrong: Had governments funded it, vaccines could arrive sooner.
trap.right: Had governments funded it, vaccines might have arrived sooner.
trap.why: O brasileiro mistura tempos (“se tivessem financiado, chegariam”). No condicional inverso passado, a principal pede would/might have + particípio.

mcq.q: ___ governments funded it, vaccines might have arrived sooner.
Had governments funded it, vaccines ___ arrived sooner.
Which is the same as “If they had left”?

fix.wrong: Had they funded it, vaccines would arrive sooner.
fix.right: Had they funded it, vaccines would have arrived sooner.

fix.wrong: Had governments fund it, it might have worked.
fix.right: Had governments funded it, it might have worked.

fix.wrong: Did they funded it, it would have worked.
fix.right: Had they funded it, it would have worked.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If governments had funded it, vaccines might have arrived sooner.”
rewrite.answer: Had governments funded it, vaccines might have arrived sooner.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If we had known, we would have called.”
rewrite.answer: Had we known, we would have called.

rewrite.prompt: Desinverta: “Had she asked, he would have answered.”
rewrite.answer: If she had asked, he would have answered.
